title.zh: 将新怡诗夏省Papaya市镇的名称正式变更为General Tinio的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Papaya in the Province of Nueva Ecija to General Tinio
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Papaya in the Province of Nueva Ecija to General Tinio
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Thị trấn Papaya tại Tỉnh Nueva Ecija thành General Tinio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อเทศบาล Papaya ในจังหวัด Nueva Ecija เป็น General Tinio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Kotamadya Papaya di Provinsi Nueva Ecija menjadi General Tinio
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Perbandaran Papaya di Wilayah Nueva Ecija menjadi General Tinio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1665_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Municipality of Papaya in the Province of Nueva Ecija is hereby changed to General Tinio.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
